description: This file defines an in-memory repository class NoteRepository for managing Note objects, providing CRUD operations and utilizing thread-safe collections.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: An in-memory thread-safe repository for storing and managing Note objects, with methods for saving, retrieving, checking existence, and deleting notes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new note or updates an existing one. Assigns IDs and timestamps as necessary.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Note by its ID, returning an Optional containing the note if found.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all stored notes.

methods.name: existsById
methods.description: Checks whether a note with the given ID exists in the store.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Removes a note from the store based on its ID.
